methodology.timing: Fresh process per engine/workload/size/round; no explicit GC or memory observer. Full transaction timing; closure setup and checksum outside the sample.
methodology.memory: Different fresh --expose-gc process; GC observer and sampled heap/RSS. Forced collections bracket workload and are reported separately.
methodology.allocation: Sampled heap high-water delta is a churn proxy, not total allocated bytes or exact peak. Retained deltas include profiler/harness overhead.
methodology.baseline: Eager full-clone reference using identical actions, state and metadata contract.
methodology.ordering: Rotate engine order by round; processes otherwise run sequentially.
methodology.correctness: Final alias/identity-aware SHA-256, versions and aggregate invalidation counts must match across engines/rounds.
